spec.description: Backend-client history, PostgreSQL server health, DB-volume capacity and current SQL diagnostics. New server/volume panels require the Collector monitoring release.

panels.title: DB Volume Free Space
panels.description: Available bytes on the filesystem backing postgres_data, shared with any other data on that filesystem. Reserved bytes are excluded. Read-only is the Collector mount mode.

panels.title: DB Volume Free %
panels.description: Free bytes / total bytes (used + free + reserved). Requires the Collector release; missing data is not zero.

panels.title: DB Volume Free Inodes %
panels.description: Free inode fraction for the DB volume's backing filesystem. Not the Collector overlay root.

panels.title: Database Size History
panels.description: Native PostgreSQL database size; not filesystem free space.

panels.title: Oldest Open Transaction
panels.description: Oldest open client transaction sampled every 30s. Short transactions can occur between scrapes. Not completed transaction latency.

panels.title: Open / Idle Transactions
panels.description: Current open transaction count includes idle transactions; these series are not additive.

panels.title: Lock Waiters
panels.description: Sessions currently waiting on a PostgreSQL Lock event. This is a sampled count, not lock wait duration.

panels.title: Deadlocks / sec
panels.description: Server deadlocks counter, reset-aware rate. Zero is normal.

panels.title: Estimated Dead Tuples
panels.description: Estimated dead rows from PostgreSQL statistics. Not exact bloat or reclaimable disk bytes.

panels.title: Autovacuum Runs — selected range
panels.description: Counter increase over selected time range. Requires >=2 samples. Polling cannot capture individual vacuum execution duration.

panels.title: Autoanalyze Runs — selected range
panels.description: Counter increase over selected time range, including counter resets.

panels.title: Time Since Last Autovacuum
panels.description: Tables with unknown/null last_autovacuum are omitted, not shown as an enormous age. Existing snapshot table still lists them.

panels.title: Table XID Age
panels.description: Transaction ID age of each table; interpretation depends on freeze settings. No automatic tuning/alerts.

panels.title: Server Backend Processes
panels.description: Includes all backend types/states, including autovacuum and parallel workers. Not client max_connections utilization.

panels.title: Buffer Cache Hit %
panels.description: PostgreSQL buffer hit ratio over the selected rate window. Excludes OS cache. Undefined when no buffer accesses occur.

panels.title: Temporary Files Write / sec
panels.description: Bytes written to temporary files by queries, not all PostgreSQL disk I/O.

panels.title: Top SQL — execution cost / sec
panels.description: Execution seconds per wall-clock second, not latency or CPU utilization; can exceed 1 with concurrent execution. Requires PostgreSQL preload/restart, public pg_stat_statements extension and Collector release. Numeric queryid/userid only; no SQL text. Monitoring-role statements are excluded; other clients including Grafana may be counted. Rankings vary over time and query identities can change after resets, eviction or DDL.

panels.title: Top SQL — calls / sec
panels.description: Most frequently executed statement identities over the rate window. Requires PostgreSQL preload/restart, public pg_stat_statements extension and Collector release. Numeric queryid/userid only; no SQL text. Monitoring-role statements are excluded; other clients including Grafana may be counted. Rankings vary over time and query identities can change after resets, eviction or DDL.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (database, userid, queryid) (rate({"commonex.postgresql.statement.execution.seconds"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (database, userid, queryid) (rate({"commonex.postgresql.statement.calls"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0))

panels.title: Top SQL — mean execution latency
panels.description: Rate-weighted mean for successful executions in the rate window. Not P95, planning time, or transaction duration; idle identities are omitted. Requires PostgreSQL preload/restart, public pg_stat_statements extension and Collector release. Numeric queryid/userid only; no SQL text. Monitoring-role statements are excluded; other clients including Grafana may be counted. Rankings vary over time and query identities can change after resets, eviction or DDL.

panels.title: Top SQL — shared blocks read / sec
panels.description: Shared buffer misses in blocks per second, not physical disk reads or bytes; the OS cache may satisfy these reads. Requires PostgreSQL preload/restart, public pg_stat_statements extension and Collector release. Numeric queryid/userid only; no SQL text. Monitoring-role statements are excluded; other clients including Grafana may be counted. Rankings vary over time and query identities can change after resets, eviction or DDL.

panels.title: Top SQL — rows / sec
panels.description: Rows retrieved or affected, not the size of returned payloads. Requires PostgreSQL preload/restart, public pg_stat_statements extension and Collector release. Numeric queryid/userid only; no SQL text. Monitoring-role statements are excluded; other clients including Grafana may be counted. Rankings vary over time and query identities can change after resets, eviction or DDL.
Counters are cumulative since stats_reset. Buffer cache hits exclude OS cache. Database size is not free disk space.

targets.rawSql: SELECT current_database() AS database, current_setting('max_connections')::int AS max_connections, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_type = 'client backend') AS cluster_client_connections, numbackends AS database_connections, pg_database_size(datid) AS database_bytes, ROUND(100.0 * blks_hit / NULLIF(blks_hit + blks_read, 0), 2) AS cache_hit_percent_since_reset, deadlocks AS deadlocks_since_reset, temp_bytes AS temp_bytes_since_reset, stats_reset FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname = current_database()

panels.title: Connections & Database Health — current snapshot

panels.description: Open transaction age, not completed transaction latency. idle in transaction is visible via state. No query text/parameters.

targets.rawSql: SELECT pid, application_name, state, ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM clock_timestamp() - xact_start)::numeric, 3) AS transaction_age_seconds, ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM clock_timestamp() - state_change)::numeric, 3) AS state_age_seconds, wait_event_type, wait_event FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = current_database() AND backend_type = 'client backend' AND xact_start IS NOT NULL AND pid <> pg_backend_pid() ORDER BY xact_start LIMIT 50

panels.title: Open Transactions — current snapshot

panels.description: Query age is NOT lock-wait duration. No query text/parameters.

targets.rawSql: SELECT pid, application_name, state, wait_event_type, wait_event, pg_blocking_pids(pid)::text AS blocking_pids, ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM clock_timestamp() - query_start)::numeric, 3) AS query_age_seconds FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = current_database() AND pid <> pg_backend_pid() AND cardinality(pg_blocking_pids(pid)) > 0 ORDER BY query_start LIMIT 50

panels.title: Blocked Sessions — current snapshot

panels.description: Live/dead rows are estimates, not measured bloat. Vacuum counters are cumulative.

targets.rawSql: SELECT schemaname, s.relname AS table_name, pg_total_relation_size(relid) AS total_bytes, pg_table_size(relid) AS table_bytes, pg_indexes_size(relid) AS index_bytes, n_live_tup AS estimated_live_rows, n_dead_tup AS estimated_dead_rows, last_autovacuum, last_autoanalyze, autovacuum_count, autoanalyze_count, age(c.relfrozenxid) AS xid_age FROM pg_stat_user_tables s JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = s.relid ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(relid) DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Table Size & Vacuum — current snapshot

panels.description: Only running VACUUM, including autovacuum. Empty result is normal when none is running.

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.pid, n.nspname AS schema_name, c.relname AS table_name, a.backend_type, p.phase, p.heap_blks_total, p.heap_blks_scanned, p.heap_blks_vacuumed, p.index_vacuum_count FROM pg_stat_progress_vacuum p JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = p.relid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_stat_activity a ON a.pid = p.pid WHERE p.datname = current_database()

panels.title: Vacuum Progress — current snapshot

options.content:
SQL tables show **current snapshots**, independent of the historical time range. Backend-client and PostgreSQL-container charts already have telemetry.

Server health, vacuum, open-transaction history and DB-volume capacity charts require deployment of the Collector configuration in infra/otel-collector. Until deployment, missing data is expected and is not mapped to zero. See infra/otel-collector/README.md for role/secret preparation and verification.

Statement rankings additionally require pg_stat_statements preload/restart and CREATE EXTENSION in the application database. They use numeric queryid/userid and rate windows, not SQL text or transaction duration. See the runbook for staged activation and reset/eviction caveats.

Still deferred: completed transaction duration; WAL-size history. No SQL text or query parameters are exported.
